name: Zaptor Matriarch
biography: The zaptor matriarch leads herds of zaptors across the desert — swift, storm-charged raptors whose bodies crackle with accumulated static. Habitat: Desert.

features.name: Lightning Body (Recharges after Using Thunderous Steps)
features.description: When a creature hits the matriarch for the first time on a turn with a melee weapon attack using a metal weapon, the matriarch discharges, and the attacking creature takes 9 (2d8) Lightning damage and drops its weapon. A creature that is Immune to Lightning damage does not drop its weapon.

features.name: Thunderous Steps (1/Turn)
features.description: When the matriarch moves 30+ feet in a straight line, she creates a burst of thunder until she stops moving. Saving Throw: DC 15 Constitution, each creature within 20 feet of the matriarch's path. Failure: 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The matriarch makes one Charged Tail attack and two Storm Kick attacks.

features.name: Charged Tail
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8, reach 15 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is wearing metal armour, it takes an extra 9 (2d8) Lightning damage.

features.name: Storm Kick
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Lightning damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the matriarch.

features.name: Discharge (Recharges after Using Thunderous Steps)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 15 Dexterity, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 27 (6d8) Lightning damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target is Paralysed until the start of its next turn. Success: Half damage.
